name: ai.datamerge/mcp
registry_description: B2B data enrichment for 375M+ companies: legal entities, corporate hierarchies, and contacts.

tools.name: configure_datamerge
tools.title: Configure DataMerge Authentication
tools.description: Configure DataMerge API authentication (required before using other tools if DATAMERGE_API_KEY is not set).

apiKey.description: DataMerge API key. Get one at https://app.datamerge.ai (20 free credits).

baseUrl.description: Optional custom API base URL (default: https://api.datamerge.ai).

tools.name: start_company_enrichment
tools.title: Start Company Enrichment
tools.description: POST /v1/company/enrich. Enrich one or more companies by domain. Returns a job_id (async). Single: domain. Batch: domains, country_code, global_ultimate, list, skip_if_exists.

company_name.description: Company name (used when domain is not available).

country_code.description: Optional ISO 2-letter country code to improve matching.

strict_match.description: When true, require a strict match for enrichment.

global_ultimate.description: When true, always return the global ultimate parent.

webhook_url.description: Optional webhook URL to receive job completion notifications.

list.description: List slug to add enriched companies to.

skip_if_exists.description: When true, skip domains that are already in the list.

tools.name: get_company_enrichment_result
tools.title: Get Company Enrichment Result
tools.description: GET /v1/company/enrich/{job_id}/status. Poll until status is "completed" or "failed". Response includes record_ids. Status values: queued Â· processing Â· completed Â· failed.

job_id.description: The enrichment job ID returned by start_company_enrichment. Poll until status is "completed" or "failed".

tools.name: start_company_enrichment_and_wait
tools.title: Start Company Enrichment and Wait
tools.description: POST /v1/company/enrich then poll GET /v1/company/enrich/{job_id}/status until status is "completed" or "failed" or timeout. Same params as start_company_enrichment plus poll_interval_seconds and timeout_seconds.

company_name.description: Company name (used when domain is not available).

country_code.description: Optional ISO 2-letter country code to improve matching.

strict_match.description: When true, require a strict match for enrichment.

global_ultimate.description: When true, always return the global ultimate parent.

webhook_url.description: Optional webhook URL to receive job completion notifications.

poll_interval_seconds.description: How often to poll the job status (in seconds). Defaults to 5 seconds.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to wait for completion (in seconds). Defaults to 60 seconds.

domains.description: Batch: multiple domains to enrich in one job.

list.description: List slug to add enriched companies to.

skip_if_exists.description: When true, skip domains already in the list.

tools.name: run_company_enrichment
tools.title: Run Company Enrichment
tools.description: Agent-friendly company enrichment. On the first call provide enrichment params (domain, domains, company_name, country_code, etc.); the server starts the job and polls internally for up to ~25s. If the job is still running, the response will be {status:"pending", continuation_token, attempt, elapsed_seconds}. When you see status "pending" you MUST immediately call run_company_enrichment again with only continuation_token set â do not ask the user, do not call any other tool first. Typical jobs finish within 5 attempts (~125s). On completion the response contains record_ids and full company records.

continuation_token.description: Opaque token from a prior pending response. When set, all other params are ignored.

domains.description: Batch: multiple domains in one job.

list.description: List slug to add enriched companies to.

refresh.description: When true, bypass DataMerge dedup: always re-enrich and charge credits even if the domain is already on a list. Use for multi-tenant resellers (e.g. Faro).

max_wait_seconds.description: Server-side wait budget per call. Default 25, hard-capped to stay under 30s timeouts.

tools.name: run_contact_enrich
tools.title: Run Contact Enrich
tools.description: Agent-friendly contact enrichment. On the first call provide contacts and enrich_fields; the server starts the job and polls internally for up to ~25s. If still running, returns {status:"pending", continuation_token, attempt, elapsed_seconds} â you MUST immediately call run_contact_enrich again with only continuation_token set. Do not ask the user. Typical jobs finish within 5 attempts. On completion the response contains record_ids and full contact records.

continuation_token.description: Opaque token from a prior pending response. When set, all other params are ignored.

contacts.description: Array of contacts. Identify each with `linkedin_url` and/or (`firstname`+`lastname`). ALWAYS include `domain` (company website) when you know it â FullEnrich's email accuracy drops sharply without a domain hint.

refresh.description: When true, bypass DataMerge dedup: always re-enrich every contact and charge credits, even if the same contact was enriched in the last 30 days. Use for multi-tenant resellers (e.g. Faro).

return_any_domain.description: Set to true to allow enrichment for contacts that have no `domain`. FullEnrich will pick whichever current employer it considers most probable, which may not match what you expect for people with multiple plausible affiliations. Default false: server returns `status: "domain_required"` if any contact lacks `domain`.

max_wait_seconds.description: Server-side wait budget per call. Default 25, hard-capped to stay under 30s timeouts.

tools.name: run_contact_search
tools.title: Run Contact Search
tools.description: Agent-friendly contact search. On the first call provide domains and enrich_fields; the server starts the job and polls internally for up to ~25s. If still running, returns {status:"pending", continuation_token, attempt, elapsed_seconds} â you MUST immediately call run_contact_search again with only continuation_token set. Do not ask the user. On completion the response contains record_ids, full contact records, and credits_consumed.

continuation_token.description: Opaque token from a prior pending response. When set, all other params are ignored.

domains.description: Company domains to search for contacts at.

max_results_per_company.description: Max contacts to return per company.

list.description: Target contact list slug for results.

refresh.description: When true, downstream enrichment bypasses dedup and always charges credits for each contact. Use for multi-tenant resellers (e.g. Faro).

max_wait_seconds.description: Server-side wait budget per call. Default 25, hard-capped to stay under 30s timeouts.

tools.name: get_company
tools.title: Get Company
tools.description: Get a single company record. GET /v1/company/get?datamerge_id={id} or ?record_id={uuid}. Provide either datamerge_id (charges 1 credit) or record_id (free). Not both. Optional: add_to_list â list slug to add the company to (only with datamerge_id).

record_id.description: Your record UUID from a previous enrichment. Does not consume credits.

add_to_list.description: List slug to add the company to. Only valid when using datamerge_id.

tools.name: get_company_hierarchy
tools.title: Get Company Hierarchy
tools.description: Get all entities in the same global ultimate hierarchy. GET /v1/company/hierarchy?datamerge_id={id}. Parameters: include_names (bool, charges 1 credit), include_branches (bool), only_subsidiaries (bool), max_level (int), country_code (array), page (int).

country_code.description: Filter entities by ISO 2-letter country code(s).

tools.name: contact_search
tools.title: Contact Search
tools.description: POST /v1/contact/search. Search for contacts at specified companies. Returns a job_id (async, 202). enrich_fields required (at least one of contact.emails or contact.phones). Use company_list (slug) instead of domains to search a saved list.

include.description: Priority-keyed: {"1": ["CEO"], "2": ["VP Sales"]} â priority "1" is highest.

location.description: Location filters: include/exclude with type and value (country, region, city).

enrich_fields.description: At least one of "contact.emails" or "contact.phones". Each email costs 1 credit; phone 4 credits.

webhook.description: Optional webhook URL to notify when the job completes.

tools.name: get_contact_search_status
tools.title: Get Contact Search Status
tools.description: GET /v1/contact/search/{job_id}/status. Poll until status is "completed" or "failed". Response includes record_ids.

job_id.description: The contact search job ID returned by contact_search. Poll until status is "completed" or "failed".

tools.name: contact_enrich
tools.title: Contact Enrich
tools.description: POST /v1/contact/enrich. Enrich specific contacts by LinkedIn URL or name+domain. Returns a job_id (async, 202).

contacts.description: Array of contacts: either { linkedin_url } or { firstname, lastname, domain }.

tools.name: get_contact_enrich_status
tools.title: Get Contact Enrich Status
tools.description: GET /v1/contact/enrich/{job_id}/status. Poll until status is "completed" or "failed". Response includes record_ids.

job_id.description: The contact enrich job ID returned by contact_enrich. Poll until status is "completed" or "failed".

tools.name: get_contact
tools.title: Get Contact
tools.description: GET /v1/contact/get?record_id={uuid}. Retrieve a specific contact by record UUID. Never charges credits.

record_id.description: Contact record UUID from a previous contact_search or contact_enrich job. Does not consume credits.

tools.name: list_lists
tools.title: List Lists
tools.description: GET /v1/lists. Optional: object_type=company or object_type=contact.

object_type.description: Filter lists by object type: company or contact.

tools.name: create_list
tools.title: Create List
tools.description: POST /v1/lists. Body: name, object_type (company or contact).

name.description: Display name for the new list.

object_type.description: Whether the list holds company or contact records.

tools.name: get_list_items
tools.title: Get List Items
tools.description: GET /v1/lists/{object_type}/{list_slug}. object_type: company or contact. list_slug: e.g. target-accounts. Parameters: page, page_size (max 100), sort_by, sort_order (asc/desc).

object_type.description: Type of list: company or contact.

tools.name: remove_list_item
tools.title: Remove List Item
tools.description: DELETE /v1/lists/{object_type}/{list_slug}/{item_id}.

object_type.description: Type of list: company or contact.

item_id.description: Record UUID of the company or contact to remove from the list.

tools.name: delete_list
tools.title: Delete List
tools.description: DELETE /v1/lists/{object_type}/{list_slug}. System lists cannot be deleted.

object_type.description: Type of list: company or contact.

list_slug.description: List slug of the list to delete. System lists cannot be deleted.

tools.name: get_credits_balance
tools.title: Get Credits Balance
tools.description: GET /v1/credits/balance. Returns credits_balance and balances (one_off, recurring, rollover, total).

_.description: This tool takes no required parameters. Call with no arguments.

tools.name: health_check
tools.title: Health Check
tools.description: Check if the DataMerge API client is configured and can connect. Uses /auth/info.

_.description: This tool takes no required parameters. Call with no arguments.

tools.name: contact_search_unenriched
tools.title: Contact Search (Unenriched, Beta)
tools.description: POST /v1/contact/search/unenriched. Find contacts without running email/phone enrichment. Returns a job_id; contacts are created in `unconfirmed` status with stable ids. BETA: requires the `contact_search_unenriched` flag on the account.

company_list.description: Alternative to domains: list slug to search across.

job_titles.description: Optional include/exclude job title filters (priority-keyed include).

tools.name: run_contact_search_unenriched
tools.title: Run Contact Search (Unenriched, Sync, Beta)
tools.description: POST /v1/contact/search/unenriched/sync. Synchronous unenriched contact search â returns contacts inline (no polling). Requires the `contact_search_unenriched` beta flag. Limits: 10 domains and max_results_per_company â¤ 10. Response includes credits_consumed computed as 0.5 Ã len(contacts).

include.description: Priority-keyed: {"1": ["CEO"], "2": ["VP"]} â priority "1" is highest. The API flattens this to a single array for the sync endpoint.
